modalities.evidence: fMRI data collected on the 11 participants while they were listening to 672 Chinese concepts
each participant can fill in as much surveys

output.population: 11 MRI participants aged 22-28 recruited from universities in Beijing, right-handed native Mandarin speakers; separate participants provided semantic feature annotations
output.summary: fMRI data recorded while participants listened to Chinese concepts, with structural scans and linguistic annotations including part-of-speech tags, category, semantic feature ratings, and word and character embeddings.
